The overview puts four KPI tiles (revenue, active users, conversion, churn) in a 2×2 grid on the left, each with a value, a label and an up or down trend. On the right, a bar chart compares each metric to the previous quarter, indexed to 100 so the different units sit on one scale. Churn trends down, which is the good direction for that metric.

The catalog has no container component other than `columns`, so I used it as the root. I wrote the nested blocks with both `type` and `component` keys because the catalog doesn't spell out the block format.
